tasks.title: E16 in full from its design
tasks.brief: You are the only coder on epic E16 (Ground console and delayed handoff). Implement it in full from its product brief docs/product/tdd/E16.md and docs/SYSTEM.md (its module, ports and seams; this epic has no design): every section, and every R, V and D of its acceptance matrix with a test, including end to end tests on the real stack. docs/build/E16/PLAN.md and ticket_tasks in docs/build/E16/tasks.json describe one split of this work with briefs, tests and gates: use them as a guide and checklist; the design and docs/SYSTEM.md win where they differ. Build in this order: domain, application, adapters, api, user interface, and run your tests as you go. If an epic you depend on has no code yet, code against its port protocol and the kernel fakes (docs/SYSTEM.md section 10).

ticket_tasks.title: Approved handoff lifecycle and ground command API
ticket_tasks.brief:
Read AGENTS.md, docs/SYSTEM.md and docs/requests/COORDINATOR-DECISIONS.md Part A first, then every reads entry. This brief stands alone. E16 has no docs/tdd/E16.md, docs/requests/E16.md or cold reviews at planning time. Implement product brief E16-01/02/03 from docs/product/tdd/E16.md:17 using SYSTEM 4.2/4.4/6.1 ownership in place of the absent design section 13. No design edits or product-code changes outside owned_paths. Recheck the current tree and all docs/build/*/tasks.json before writing; implementation paths were absent during planning. New private filenames are allocated only within the exact owned directories; module.py/application/ports.py/replica.schema.json follow SYSTEM conventions. Never create a provider's module or handwritten shared wire model. No git. English only, no em/en dashes or spaced hyphen dash. Existing finite bounds are commands.max_bytes/storage.max_rows/storage.max_statement_bytes for admission/read work, sync.max_bytes/sync.max_projection_fields/sync.max_dependencies for projections, events.page_size/event_bus.max_events and registry.max_modules/max_ports/max_hooks/startup_timeout_ms for events/discovery. E29 alone owns bundle/sync dispatch/retry bounds from SYSTEM 5.11. Register no new key/default; C5/C6 supplies accepted response/browser bounds before enabling those paths.

Use SYSTEM 5.1 IdFactory/require_id; 5.2 Clock, TimeInput and correction provenance; 5.3 MissionClock; 5.4 Decimal Quantity/Unit and conversion provenance; 5.5 ProblemError/StorageUnavailable and ErrorEnvelope HTTP mapping; 5.6 ReleaseHandle/ConfigReader/ConfigReleaseReader/TemplateRenderer and atomic validation; 5.7 UnitOfWork/ReadSnapshot/StorageSession, mandatory audiences and atomic replication declarations; 5.7.1 exact approved projections; 5.8 CommandIdentity/IdempotencyStore/ResultVisibility/CommandReceipts and mission-life ledger; 5.9 reference-only AuditEntry/hash chain; 5.10 AbsoluteDeadline/ElapsedDeadline and bounded scheduler; 5.11 HubSettings/SettingSpec; 5.12 ModuleRegistry discovery. Never implement replacement transaction, identity, migration, retry, clock or recovery mechanisms. D5 means ErrorEnvelope on HTTP, sanitized RFC 9457 in logs. D6 binds actor/operation/target/semantic parameters/body and reauthorizes replay; 409 alone never proves acceptance. D9/SYSTEM 8.3 deny officer-wide or ground live-chart access. SYSTEM 6.2 uses uv --project hub, 6.3 pnpm and @crew-health/contracts, 6.4 generated import contracts, 6.5 effective generated models. SYSTEM 8.1 freezes approved content; 8.3 applies current object/field/purpose grants to every exit, cache and replay; 8.6 preserves accepted records. SYSTEM 9/10 requires E01/E02/E15, treats E09/E29 as optional and supplies kernel.testing. Unit tests may use those bounded fakes only against documented protocols; real-stack tests cannot mock internal hub services.

C1 to C7 in PLAN.md are coordinator handoffs, not filed/accepted contracts. Consolidate shared transport/presentation/runner requests with E29 P29-1/2/3/4; do not define a competing protocol family. Require their published exact provider declarations, generated effective schema and owned toolchain before dependent implementation. Unknown or missing seams block that work; no permissive stub, copied module, invented signature, silent default, test skip/xfail or weakened acceptance. Do available independent work and report blockers. Domain/UI content comes only from validated versioned configuration or authorized API state; examples are illustrative inputs, never production seeds. Demo/test content lives only in fixtures/ or eval/ and loads through an explicit profile. Invalid activation retains last good configuration; approved work retains pins. Nothing depends on the model/devices/ground for onboard care. Do not fabricate missing values, convert receipt time to observation freshness, average conflicts or send journals/participation. Every parser/policy has property tests with independent expected safety/privacy outcomes and zero/negative/empty/maximum cases. Write critical regressions first, run full suites after a bug fix, and report every blocked/failed gate. Done requires owned gates, full assigned acceptance, resolved independent review, CI and coordinator AI-use rows. A unit-only or absent-provider result is not acceptance.

Build the single handoff backend lifecycle, E16-01 to E16-03. Own hub/src/crew_health/handoff/ and hub/tests/handoff/ only (SYSTEM 4.1/4.2/6.1, docs/SYSTEM.md:76 and :103). T2/T3 own UI; T4 owns whole V/D scenarios. E29 owns transport, contacts, simulated dispatch, retry, GroundLogComposer/GroundLogView and getGroundLog. E26 owns GroundMessage and help logs; E15/E28 own episode/plan links. No local scheduler-based simulator, FHIR exporter, private store, client queue, model call or clinical rule.

Use only handoff_handoff and handoff_receipt, exact table names from SYSTEM 4.2. Store immutable selected snapshots plus append-only ground receipt/reply records under the agreed C1 schema, with same-subject/mission/origin/revision checks and bounded indexes. Keep every reply, authenticated actor, original time and stable identity; expose only the contracted latest reply, never discard earlier accepted advice. Define no third table or wire field without a coordinator allocation. Migrations use SYSTEM 4.1/5.7 and expand-only compatibility, never private transaction control. Persist initial preview timeline time as creation time; preserve it on ground reads. Repository adapters alone use StorageSession. Register ports, module/router, id prefixes, required settings, local audience schema, replica.schema.json and handoff/approved/1 through SYSTEM 5.7.1/5.12, without editing app/platform. Replica application writes only agreed owned replica state, never authoritative remote clinical state. Unapproved changes use explicit local-only replication declarations.

Public operations copied from docs/product/api/openapi.yaml:5751, :9356, :9414, :9506, :9601 and :9693: POST /v1/handoffs previewHandoff (HandoffCreate to 201 Handoff); GET /v1/handoffs/{handoff_id} getHandoff (200 Handoff and ETag); POST /v1/handoffs/{handoff_id}/approve approveHandoff (HandoffApprove to 200 Handoff, If-Match); GET /v1/ground/inbox getGroundInbox (200 GroundInbox); POST /v1/ground/handoffs/{handoff_id}/receipt recordHandoffReceipt and /reply replyToHandoff (GroundReceipt/GroundReply to Handoff); POST /v1/ground/messages/{ground_message_id}/receipt recordGroundMessageReceipt and /reply replyToGroundMessage (same requests to GroundMessage). Ground commands and inbox are ground-role only. Preview/approval are crew or crew_medical_officer; getHandoff also admits ground only for delivered authorized snapshots. Authentication comes from E02, never request actor fields. Copy all operation headers/status/error sets from effective OpenAPI, including Config-Release, X-Correlation-Id, Idempotency-Key, Location and VERSION_REQUIRED/STALE_VERSION. Error current_state cannot leak inaccessible content. E16 owns /ground/messages commands per docs/tdd/E26.md:46, not the onboard GroundMessage API.

HandoffCreate has episode_id, nonempty fields/recipients, optional attachments/consent_ref. HandoffApprove has required previewed_revision; GroundReceipt required received_at; GroundReply required text (requests.schema.json:1002/1040/1961/1973). Do not accept an undeclared plan_run_id before C4. Generated Handoff has exactly the state enum draft/previewed/approved/queued/in_transit/delivered/receipt_recorded/delivery_failed/cancelled/expired, nullable consent_ref/approved_by/approved_at/reply/leaves_at/catch_up/plan_run_id, fields, attachments, recipients, deliveries, simulated, timeline and allowed_actions. DeliveryAttempt/ReviewerReply are product entities represented by generated nested deliveries/reply shapes, not permission for new shared DTOs. Delivery transport enum is simulated_comms_queue/local_export. HandoffSnapshot is the immutable approved selection described in CONTRACTS 3/4. No endpoint for cancellation/export/retry is invented; C5 settles unsupported advertised actions.

Preview uses C1/C3's current authorized EpisodeReader content and configured field mapping, accepts only selected permitted fields, excludes journal/participation and defaults sensitive selections off. Source values retain unit/source/time/origin and explicit unknown/conflict. E09 ReportQueries provides only separately owner-approved immutable attachment versions; absence makes requested attachments unavailable, never silently omitted with success. No private report-source table/vault access. Resolve recipient strings and optional consent_ref against current authenticated recipient/field/purpose grants, never trust arbitrary labels as authorization. Freeze fields, attachments, recipients, consent, source versions, catch_up and release before display; approval compares both previewed_revision and ETag atomically. Unknown/missing consent denies. Same preview remains stable after later clinical/config changes; changed content needs another preview. Approval durably queues without E29. Missing E29 gives truthful unknown contact/transport, no invented attempt or arrival; C2 defines its presentation facade without forbidden GroundLinkQuery imports. Use ui-copy.json catch_up_words/designed_states.unknown/error_messages plus C3's accepted labels/templates; no new content document. C1/C3 must specify the missing-E29 composition fallback: what_happened uses only the selected authorized concern/observations, known done facts are preserved when supplied, unavailable watch/advice uses configured unknown. No fake composer supplies production facts. Unknown watch/advice is not nothing_watched. A scratch non-safety label edit changes served content; invalid candidate keeps last good release.

Ground reads and mutations require delivered approved projection and current recipient grant. Persist receipt/reply at ground and queue its new return record after commit through C1/E29; delay the onboard effect until authenticated return delivery. GroundMessage return effects go only through E26 GroundMessageLifecyclePort.record_receipt/record_reply (docs/tdd/E26.md:470), invoked by E29 under the agreed transaction protocol, never direct help-table writes. Handoff return callbacks verify immutable target/snapshot/hash/recipient/origin and ordering. Reordered or duplicate effects cannot roll state backward or replace newer replies; retain full history. Ground inbox merges handoffs and delivered E26 messages through C1's bounded reader; E26 absence is an explicit capability state, not invented empty clinical data. No transport receipt calls recordReview or changes an episode, plan, help step or warning. Ground scope events come from E29 only after delivery (SYSTEM 8.3), never from queue approval. Use producer person-scope handoff.changed and required current-field audience checks. After approval export only allowed handoff/approved/1 leaf fields; do not leak episode/report/plan links or dependencies not separately authorized.

Tests first trace E16-01/R19/V26, E16-02/R19/V29 and E16-03/R19/V95 plus AGENTS durability/privacy/no-fabrication invariants. Unit/property tests cover all valid/invalid state transitions, actor/field/recipient matrix, same key different target/parameters/body, stale/missing revision, approval racing revoke, immutable preview after source/config changes, source mismatch, unknown/null times, every numeric/byte/list bound and multiple/out-of-order replies. Repository/composition integration uses real temporary SQLite to crash before/after snapshot, approval and receipt commits and before client ACK; audit/ledger/outbox/replication failure rolls back all. Disk full/locked/I/O/corruption are never swallowed. Retry after 24 hours replays the authorized original receipt, not new content; revoked visibility denies even its reference. Corrupt/missing configuration is loud; old pins persist. Forward/backward clock corrections and mission-day boundary preserve snapshot/observation times; absolute contact never shifts, elapsed delays use E29's shared scheduler. Absent model/devices/E09/E29 and absent/incapacitated owner preserve local care and never imply new sharing permission. Partial/disagreeing readings are kept with reasons. T4 repeats full paths over real HTTP/Playwright and verifies long backlog. Do not claim full V/D coverage here. Done requires these tests and strict static/branch gates, schema-valid operations/headers, exact provider interface evidence, atomic immutable approval and delivered-only ground access; unresolved C1 to C5 block affected acceptance.
gates: uv run --project hub pytest -c hub/pyproject.toml -q hub/tests/handoff --cov=crew_health.handoff.domain --cov-branch --cov-fail-under=95
uv run --project hub pytest -c hub/pyproject.toml -q hub/tests/handoff --cov=crew_health.handoff.application --cov-branch --cov-fail-under=95
uv run --project hub ruff check hub/src/crew_health/handoff hub/tests/handoff
uv run --project hub ruff format --check hub/src/crew_health/handoff hub/tests/handoff

Clinical data and reply drafts stay only in reader-session memory per SYSTEM 8.3. Before using E20's command journal, require C6's policy for sensitive Handoff fields; no new browser persistence or service-worker cache for P2/P3. Use the shell sessionEpoch/session-loss clearing hooks, fence late responses and subscriptions, clear on lock/sign-out/grant/owner loss. Network/SSE loss shows as-of/stale and disables unsupported mutation; reconnect refetches current authorized data after CURSOR_EXPIRED. Only validate accepted_command receipts with matching immutable key/operation/normalized target under D6; a bare 409 is an error. No new queue implementation if that interface is absent.

Write tests first for E16-01/R19/V26/D13, crew clauses of V29/E16-02, EI5/V95 and AGENTS privacy/config invariants. Component/fast-check cases cover exact selected versus excluded fields, null/unknown and all state enums, sensitive unchecked defaults, changed preview/ETag, wrong recipient, source mismatch, keyboard actions and non-color status. Independently expected canary exclusion and actor/consent denial cannot be derived solely from input configuration. Playwright specs live inside this feature and run against normally composed T1 hub with real temporary SQLite and real shell, no mocked hub routes. Create/preview/approve via authenticated APIs and UI, link down, model stopped/devices absent; verify queued content and local care continue (D13). Read a delivered/receipt/reply history with original creation time; receive a late reply after the real plan closes (V95), no step or episode transition. Test lock/sign-out, revoke while open, account switch racing response, browser reload and hub loss with no clinical persistence/leak. Inject corrupt configuration/disk-full approval using E01 controls; show not accepted, retry same intent after restart. Clock correction/mission boundary never restamps historical facts or infers current safety; absent/incapacitated subject and unavailable transport never imply sharing permission. T4 owns whole V29/V81/D40 acceptance; do not substitute component tests for that evidence. No gamification on shared-care screens (UX 11). Done requires the owned unit/Playwright/static gates, real shell mount, configured labels, exact preview approval and privacy lifecycle; missing C3/C4/C6 leaves associated acceptance blocked. Python lint/types/imports belong to T1/T4, since this task owns no Python package.
gates: pnpm -C ui/crew exec playwright test src/features/handoff

Handoff/GroundInbox/GroundMessage/GroundLogView/common catch_up, nested deliveries/reply, GroundReceipt(received_at) and GroundReply(text) come from their schemas/requests; do not create duplicate shared interfaces. GroundInbox.as_of is not snapshot creation time. Use timeline's initial preview time until an accepted schema says otherwise; do not invent created_at. A locally exported file is not delivered and never appears as received. Closed/unknown/missing fields stay explicit. Subscribe only to authorized post-delivery handoff.changed/ground_message.changed; a queued flight object cannot be fetched by ID or exposed by event. A disappearing grant removes data and drafts, including responses already in flight. Do not provide editable crew facts or editable Open MCT objects that can change clinical data. Receipt/reply are new ground records, not permission to alter a snapshot or plan. Ground replies are attributed advice and transmitted back by E29; UI must not imply onboard arrival at submit time. Receipt is separate from clinical review and does not call recordReview. Show original text unchanged as inert text, never executable HTML/instructions.

Render C3's versioned ui-copy vocabulary and backend-rendered title/text plus catch_up_words/designed_states.unknown/origin_words/error_messages; no hardcoded content or mission durations. Invalid activation stays on last good config; approval pins remain fixed. Disable unsupported mutations during connection loss; drafts remain in the current authenticated ground reader's memory only. No browser localStorage/IndexedDB/service-worker persistence of clinical payloads or reply drafts. Clear view, pending requests and SSE on sign-out/expiry/revocation/owner change. Client receipt retries obey SYSTEM 5.8 full accepted_command validation; mismatched identity stays rejected, never reminted.

Tests first: E16-03/R19/R26/V95 positive and denied ground paths, R19/V26 privacy, E16-02/V29 truthful delivery, AGENTS content/integrity invariants. Component/fast-check tests cover every nullable/state/origin branch, literal-text rendering of malicious reply content, correct kind/ref_id endpoint dispatch, no raw chart fetch, no simulator ambiguity, all list/byte bounds, configuration label edit and no claim of zero/none for unknown input. Independently expected exclusion/authorization cases accompany generated example tests. Owned Playwright specs launch the built Open MCT app against a running normally composed hub with real temporary SQLite and real E02/T1/E26/E29. Verify ground authentication, no inbox/detail/SSE exposure while queued, delivery makes exactly approved data visible, receipt/reply submission and authenticated actor/time, same key retry versus changed target conflict, and original creation time after an extended outage. Close the real plan and then deliver/duplicate/reorder replies; no care state changes (V95). Exercise network loss/reconnect, stale cursor, grant revocation/session loss with late HTTP/SSE replies and reload; no retained clinical state crosses sessions. Crash/disk-full ground acceptance cannot show success; clock jump/mission boundary does not restamp the snapshot. Model/devices absent, report-provider absent and incapacitated crew do not alter access rules; corrupt config fails visibly. T4 owns full backlog/fault and V/D evidence. Done requires actual offline Open MCT build, unit and real browser/static gates, configured copy, current grants, delivered-only reads and truthful attributed commands; C1/C3/C5/C6 prerequisites cannot be waived. This task has no Python package, so its Python lint/types/import obligations are T1/T4 gates.

ticket_tasks.title: Real-stack privacy, outage and late-reply acceptance
ticket_tasks.brief:
Read AGENTS.md, docs/SYSTEM.md and docs/requests/COORDINATOR-DECISIONS.md Part A first, then every reads entry. This brief stands alone. E16 has no docs/tdd/E16.md, docs/requests/E16.md or cold reviews at planning time. Implement product brief E16-01/02/03 from docs/product/tdd/E16.md:17 using SYSTEM 4.2/4.4/6.1 ownership in place of the absent design section 13. No design edits or product-code changes outside owned_paths. Recheck the current tree and all docs/build/*/tasks.json before writing; implementation paths were absent during planning. New private filenames are allocated only within the exact owned directories; module.py/application/ports.py/replica.schema.json follow SYSTEM conventions. Never create a provider's module or handwritten shared wire model. No git. English only, no em/en dashes or spaced hyphen dash. Existing finite bounds are commands.max_bytes/storage.max_rows/storage.max_statement_bytes for admission/read work, sync.max_bytes/sync.max_projection_fields/sync.max_dependencies for projections, events.page_size/event_bus.max_events and registry.max_modules/max_ports/max_hooks/startup_timeout_ms for events/discovery. E29 alone owns bundle/sync dispatch/retry bounds from SYSTEM 5.11. Register no new key/default; C5/C6 supplies accepted response/browser bounds before enabling those paths.

Use SYSTEM 5.1 IdFactory/require_id; 5.2 Clock, TimeInput and correction provenance; 5.3 MissionClock; 5.4 Decimal Quantity/Unit and conversion provenance; 5.5 ProblemError/StorageUnavailable and ErrorEnvelope HTTP mapping; 5.6 ReleaseHandle/ConfigReader/ConfigReleaseReader/TemplateRenderer and atomic validation; 5.7 UnitOfWork/ReadSnapshot/StorageSession, mandatory audiences and atomic replication declarations; 5.7.1 exact approved projections; 5.8 CommandIdentity/IdempotencyStore/ResultVisibility/CommandReceipts and mission-life ledger; 5.9 reference-only AuditEntry/hash chain; 5.10 AbsoluteDeadline/ElapsedDeadline and bounded scheduler; 5.11 HubSettings/SettingSpec; 5.12 ModuleRegistry discovery. Never implement replacement transaction, identity, migration, retry, clock or recovery mechanisms. D5 means ErrorEnvelope on HTTP, sanitized RFC 9457 in logs. D6 binds actor/operation/target/semantic parameters/body and reauthorizes replay; 409 alone never proves acceptance. D9/SYSTEM 8.3 deny officer-wide or ground live-chart access. SYSTEM 6.2 uses uv --project hub, 6.3 pnpm and @crew-health/contracts, 6.4 generated import contracts, 6.5 effective generated models. SYSTEM 8.1 freezes approved content; 8.3 applies current object/field/purpose grants to every exit, cache and replay; 8.6 preserves accepted records. SYSTEM 9/10 requires E01/E02/E15, treats E09/E29 as optional and supplies kernel.testing. Unit tests may use those bounded fakes only against documented protocols; real-stack tests cannot mock internal hub services.

C1 to C7 in PLAN.md are coordinator handoffs, not filed/accepted contracts. Consolidate shared transport/presentation/runner requests with E29 P29-1/2/3/4; do not define a competing protocol family. Require their published exact provider declarations, generated effective schema and owned toolchain before dependent implementation. Unknown or missing seams block that work; no permissive stub, copied module, invented signature, silent default, test skip/xfail or weakened acceptance. Do available independent work and report blockers. Domain/UI content comes only from validated versioned configuration or authorized API state; examples are illustrative inputs, never production seeds. Demo/test content lives only in fixtures/ or eval/ and loads through an explicit profile. Invalid activation retains last good configuration; approved work retains pins. Nothing depends on the model/devices/ground for onboard care. Do not fabricate missing values, convert receipt time to observation freshness, average conflicts or send journals/participation. Every parser/policy has property tests with independent expected safety/privacy outcomes and zero/negative/empty/maximum cases. Write critical regressions first, run full suites after a bug fix, and report every blocked/failed gate. Done requires owned gates, full assigned acceptance, resolved independent review, CI and coordinator AI-use rows. A unit-only or absent-provider result is not acceptance.

Build only real-stack scenario tests/evidence in eval/scenarios/E16/, allocated by SYSTEM 4.3/6.1 (docs/SYSTEM.md:138 and :1652). No product code, fixture/runner edits or provider fakes invented here. Follow T1/T2/T3. Use E21's explicit fixtures/demo-mara-fd19 profile and existing runner/authenticated seed/fault controls once C6 is delivered. Scenario-local helper/control data stays under this owned eval directory. E21 owns eval/scenarios/conftest.py, runner, registry, demo fixtures, capability manifest and cross-epic aggregate evidence; return the exact registration mapping to its owner. Tests directly run create_app(settings) through the normal composition root with real temporary-directory SQLite and authenticated HTTP, or use Playwright against that running hub and actual crew/Open MCT apps. No mocks inside hub, direct table seeding, app dependency overrides or in-hub test branches. External optional workers/transport may use only already documented adapters. E01 controls inject storage faults/time without mocking services. Kernel fakes may support unit development but cannot earn V/D acceptance.

Inputs and ownership are SYSTEM 4/5/8/9/10 and product CONTRACTS 4/12/16/18/19/26/28, PRD R19/R26, E16-01/02/03, VALIDATION V26/V29/V68/V81/V95 and D13/D26/D40/D42 (docs/product/VALIDATION.md:46, :49, :88, :101, :115, :168, :181, :195, :197). T1 provides handoff_handoff/handoff_receipt, HandoffQueries/GroundInboxView and handoff endpoints; E26 owns GroundMessage; E29 owns transport/catch_up/getGroundLog; E15/E28 own care state. Use only C1/C2/C4's accepted exact callbacks, response schemas and API operations. Relevant wire requests: HandoffCreate, HandoffApprove(previewed_revision), GroundReceipt(received_at), GroundReply(text). Operations: previewHandoff/getHandoff/approveHandoff, getGroundInbox, recordHandoffReceipt/replyToHandoff, recordGroundMessageReceipt/replyToGroundMessage, getGroundMessage/getGroundLog. Discover exact create/read/action/auth/consent/plan/help operations from their opened effective contracts before use, not this brief's invented shortcut. Current base HandoffCreate cannot take plan_run_id: C4 is a prerequisite to D40, no episode-based inference. Tables belong to T1; tests inspect accepted effects through HTTP/event/checkpoint evidence, never cross-module repositories or SQL mutations. GroundLink up/delayed/down controls belong to E29 and are explicitly demo-only.

Write failing scenarios first and trace every assertion by R/V/D or AGENTS invariant. E16-01/R19/V26/D13: authenticate subject, record clinical input and a journal canary through owner APIs, choose exact fields and separately approved report attachments, preview/approve, then test ground HTTP/SSE/export/log/cache absence of excluded data. Independently assert canary/participation/foreign subject denied rather than deriving expectations from selected input. Wrong consent/recipient/purpose/field, assistant approval, station and officer-only authority fail; exact authorized projection succeeds. Change a non-safety label/template in a scratch validated release, prove HTTP/UI changes without code, invalid config rejects atomically and old approved bytes/pins remain. Source corrections/observations while preview is open require explicit re-preview if content changes; stale ETag/revision does not enqueue.

E16-02/R19/V29: queue with link down, model/devices absent; local care proceeds. Restart before/after snapshot, approval, send, arrival, receipt/reply and client acknowledgment commits, retaining exact stable IDs/hash/pin and only one logical receiving record. Test same key with another target, body or semantic parameter, full identity retry beyond cache expiry with intervening clinical changes, and revoked saved-result visibility. Exercise long bounded backlog and contact ordering, no chart backfill. File creation is export only; sent/in_transit is not delivered/read; all simulated events identify simulator. Missing E29 leaves durable local queue and unknown contact, missing bundle_lifetime disables BPv7 only and preserves existing simulated queue. Real E29 with file-drop backup transports the same approved snapshot when its primary documented adapter is removed; neither path invents a second payload. Test expiration/renewal, signature/hash/source/recipient mismatch, missing authorized dependency, forbidden dependency and policy epoch/revocation before materialize/send/apply, under SYSTEM 5.7.1/DEPLOYMENT 4.3/4.6. Stop ground node and restore contact: every approved record arrives once; forbidden records never appear.

E16-03/R19/R26/V95: authenticated ground console reads original preview/observation times, records receipt and two distinct replies, then retries/duplicates/reorders return envelopes. Close real E28 plan before delivery; verify all advice remains new attributed history on the correct handoff/episode, latest reply uses accepted occurrence ordering, and no plan step, episode clinical state, help step or warning changes. Wrong resource kind/target/hash/recipient cannot apply. A transport or read receipt creates no ClinicalReview. Concurrent submit/revoke/reply remains atomic. Test second crew member, sign-out/reload, ground/crew account switch and delayed HTTP/SSE delivery for no clinical leak. Source SIM/REPLAY/LIVE stays labeled and separate; missing/disagreeing values remain honest.

V68/D26/D42: real E26 help preview/press on Mars with down link shows delay/contact; later ticks continue while approved GroundMessage waits. Return contact sends exact approved text through E29 and E16 inbox/receipt/reply, never recomposes or restarts the help flow. Journal canary absent. V81/D40/EI1/EI2/EI5: real ICL10 plan on frozen demo has required order/ground stage last, particular-run handoff preview/approval, queued leaves_at=next_contact_at, local actions/closure while queued. With one fixed injected clock and a planned gap or the sourced null silence threshold, compare plan/help/warning/routine responses up/delayed/down. For PlanView allow only ground_log.link_text/leaves_at; for other responses whitelist only their exact contracted ground presentation leaves. Never normalize care state, revisions, IDs, timestamps, ordering, warning facts or availability to make the comparison pass. Inspect shared read/import trace, no new GroundLinkQuery reader. Real closed-plan late reply changes no step. Run full scenarios, not E16-only fragments with the same ID; missing E26/E28/E29 blocks their acceptance but never becomes an onboard runtime dependency.

AGENTS 6 fault matrix: disk full/audit/outbox/ledger/replication storage failures at each local acceptance phase; missing/corrupt config and last-good pin; forward/backward clock corrections, same raw time in distinct segments, mission-day boundary, absolute contact versus elapsed transit/retry, duplicate jobs/events; concurrent clients and revoked grants; long outage/backlog; absent/incapacitated subject; partial/implausible/conflicting readings; unavailable E09/E29/model/devices. Verify no swallowed storage error or premature ACK, no accepted record loss, no remote erasure claim, no unbounded history cap, no fabricated measurement or care-state change. Restore older backup only through E01's fenced current-ledger/current-grant recovery, never file replacement; old revoked grants cannot reopen access. Backup/restore/config internals remain shared-owner code. T1/T2/T3 fix their defects, tests here first capture regressions; you never edit their files.

Use pytest requirement markers/test IDs accepted by E21; no filter that can omit the claimed scenarios. Full task directory runs with the hub pyproject to avoid root pharmacy test settings. C6 registers discovery, Schemathesis operation scope, traceability, full condition evidence and mutation thresholds for E16 durability/privacy paths in the shared validate_hub gate (docs/tdd/E20.md:722); never invent a feature runner or threshold. Gate failure/missing path/provider is blocked, no skip/xfail/network or wall-clock sleep workaround. T1 owns its domain/application branch gates; this task runs the assembled contract/trace/safety/mutation check plus all real scenarios and full hub suite, including actual UI evidence through the published E21 browser driver. Done requires every complete assigned V/D clause and critical path, all listed gates, verified E21 R26 capability contribution, independent review and CI. No running implementation exists at planning time, so report evidence as planned until executed.
